claims: Assess and manage severe anemia (Hgb 7.8 g/dL, Hct 24.2%) with consideration for transfusion and evaluation for bleeding source.
Evaluate acute kidney injury with creatinine 5.1 mg/dL and BUN 57 mg/dL; assess volume status and nephrotoxic exposures.
Monitor and manage metabolic acidosis with bicarbonate 17 mEq/L and anion gap 15 mEq/L.
Review subtherapeutic phenytoin level (1.5 ug/mL) and adjust anticonvulsant dosing per indication.
Monitor blood pressure given hypotension (ABP 103/44, MAP 67) and antihypertensive medications; adjust as needed.
Continue hyperkalemia and hyperphosphatemia monitoring (K 4.3, phosphate 5.6) in setting of renal dysfunction.
Perform wound care for impaired skin area (1.5 x 1 cm) and implement pressure injury prevention given Braden bedfast score.
Maintain fall precautions given history of falls and bed rest status.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis assessment and mobilization as tolerated.
Recheck complete blood count and renal function within 24 hours to trend anemia and AKI.
